data.raw_text:
Heavy rainfall from severe thunderstorms over the past few days triggered successive landslides and flooding in Bindoy, Negros Oriental, disrupting traffic as clearing operations continued on New Year’s Day.

Dahan-dahang dumadaan ang ilang motorista sa binahang kalsada upang makaiwas sa disgrasya. #FloodPatrol | via @darylle_marie
